introHtml: Hicaliber adhesive notepads offer a reliable writing surface with strong adhesion, making them ideal for office use, trade shows, and client gifts. Available in various sizes from 2" x 3" to 4" x 6", these notepads can be customized with your logo or message using full-color print. Choose between 25, 50, or 100 sheets per pad to fit your budget and usage. Perfect for marketing directors and HR managers looking for practical, everyday promotional items that keep your brand top-of-mind.
